# Motion prompt (placeholder)

Write `motionPrompt` for Seedance 2.5 image-to-video (`dreamina-seedance-2-5`). The clip starts from the still.

- One camera move, the pace, and `durationSec` (5 or 10).
- Do not mention an output ratio. With a first-frame image, the video follows the still. Sending `ratio` returns 400.
- Repeat the on-screen cast descriptors so identity does not drift.
- Keep "AI-generated scene."
